tools.name: search_opportunities
tools.description: Search active federal contract opportunities on SAM.gov: solicitations, presolicitations, sources sought, RFIs, and award notices - filterable by keywords, NAICS, set-aside (SDVOSB, 8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, small business), notice type, agency, and posted-date range (max 1 year). Call this when the user wants to find federal bidding opportunities or market intelligence on what agencies are buying. Requires the caller's own free SAM.gov API key (X-Sam-Api-Key header or sam_api_key argument); without one it returns an error explaining how to get and pass a key.

set_aside.description: Set-aside codes: SDVOSBC/SDVOSBS (SDVOSB), VSA/VSS (VOSB), SBA/SBP (small business), 8A/8AN, HZC/HZS (HUBZone), WOSB/EDWOSB

notice_type.description: o=solicitation, p=presolicitation, r=sources sought, k=combined synopsis, g=surplus, s=special notice, a=award notice, i=intent to bundle, u=J&A

posted_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD (default: 90 days ago; SAM allows at most a 1-year window)

sam_api_key.description: Your own free SAM.gov API key. Required unless it is already set as the X-Sam-Api-Key header on the MCP connection; this server has no shared SAM.gov key. Get one free at sam.gov: sign in, open your profile (Account Details), request a public API key. Docs: https://open.gsa.gov/api/get-opportunities-public-api/. Never logged or stored.

tools.name: lookup_entity
tools.description: Look up a federal contractor registration in SAM.gov by Unique Entity ID (UEI) or legal business name: registration status, CAGE code, physical address, business types (SDVOSB, 8(a), HUBZone, etc.), and NAICS codes. Call this to vet a teaming partner, check a competitor, or confirm an entity is award-eligible. Public registration sections only. Requires the caller's own free SAM.gov API key (X-Sam-Api-Key header or sam_api_key argument).

name.description: Legal business name (partial match allowed) - used when no UEI given

sam_api_key.description: Your own free SAM.gov API key. Required unless it is already set as the X-Sam-Api-Key header on the MCP connection; this server has no shared SAM.gov key. Get one free at sam.gov: sign in, open your profile (Account Details), request a public API key. Docs: https://open.gsa.gov/api/get-opportunities-public-api/. Never logged or stored.

tools.name: search_awards
tools.description: Search actual federal contract awards on USAspending.gov - who won what, from which agency, for how much. Filter by keywords, NAICS, PSC, recipient name, agency, date range, and award amount. Keyless and unlimited. Call this for competitive intelligence ("who holds contracts in this space"), incumbent research, or agency spending patterns.

agency_name.description: Awarding toptier agency name, e.g. "Department of Defense"

tools.name: get_award
tools.description: Get full detail for one federal award from USAspending.gov by its generated award id (from search_awards results, e.g. "CONT_AWD_...") - description, obligations, period of performance, awarding/funding agencies, recipient, and place of performance. Keyless.

tools.name: find_agency
tools.description: Resolve a federal agency name fragment to its official awarding-agency names (toptier and subtier) as USAspending knows them - use before search_awards or spending_by_category when unsure of the exact agency name. Keyless.

tools.name: find_naics
tools.description: Resolve an industry description to NAICS codes (or look up what a NAICS code means). Use before search_opportunities/search_awards to get the right code. Keyless.

query.description: Industry description ("cybersecurity services") or a NAICS code ("541512")

tools.name: spending_by_category
tools.description: Aggregate federal contract spending by NAICS, PSC, recipient, or awarding agency over a date range, optionally filtered by keywords/NAICS/agency - market sizing in one call ("top contractors in NAICS 541512 last year", "which agencies buy the most cybersecurity"). Keyless.
